core_obligations: Bound the fibres on an affine neighbourhood (openness of bounded fibre dimension + closedness of f).

Closed-immersion approximation X = lim X_i (lemma-proper-limit-of-proper-finite-presentation) with fibre dimensions bounded at a finite level (lemma-limit-dimension); transfer the vanishing through R f_* = R f_{i,*}(closed immersion)_* and Leray.
Second approximation over an affine Noetherian Y (descend-finite-presentation, eventually-proper, limit-dimension); transfer H^p through the affine morphism X -> X_0.
Noetherian case: F = colim F_i coherent (directed colimit of fp modules), cohomology commutes with the colimit, and the Noetherian vanishing lemma finishes.
proof_roadmap: Approximate X by proper fp X_i.
Approximate the base by Noetherian affines.
Colimit of coherent sheaves; Noetherian vanishing.
difficulty_reason: Four-stage reduction chain, each a genuine approximation lemma: proper with bounded fibres -> affine base -> finite presentation approximation with closed immersions -> Noetherian base -> coherent sheaf by filtered colimit; the final step quotes the Noetherian vanishing.

compared.difference: That lemma assumes the vanishing and derives base-change control; this one derives the vanishing from the fibre dimension. Complementary.
